title: Londorossi Route · 7 days
content:
Your adventure begins upon arrival at

Kilimanjaro International Airport

, where our driver will warmly greet you and transfer you to your

Hotel

. After enjoying a delightful meal and a pre-trekking briefing from your guide and mountain coordinators, you can relax and take advantage of the hotel’s amenities, including the swimming pool, garden, and restaurant.

The following day, you’ll drive to

Londorossi Park Gate

to start your hike to

Shira 1 Camp

. Over the next few days, you’ll trek through stunning landscapes, including the ascent of the

Barranco Wall

and the

Lava Tower

, before reaching

Barafu Camp

, where you’ll prepare for the summit attempt.

On

Day 7

, you’ll rise early for the challenging summit ascent to

Uhuru Peak

, experiencing a breathtaking sunrise before descending to

Mweka Camp

. After completing the climb, you’ll return to

Mweka Gate

and transfer back to Sal salinero  Hotel for a hot meal and refreshing shower.

To extend your adventure, you can opt for a safari or explore

Zanzibar’s

beautiful beaches and rich culture. For more information, please visit our

Day Trip

and

Safari

pages, or check out our

Zanzibar

options for additional excursions.

faqs.title: How long does it take to climb Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: The duration of a Kilimanjaro climb typically ranges from 5 to 10 days, depending on the chosen route and your acclimatization needs. Longer treks allow for better acclimatization and increase the chances of reaching the summit.

faqs.title: What is the best time to climb Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: The best times to climb are during the dry seasons, which run from late June to October and from mid-January to March. These months generally offer clearer skies and better weather conditions.

faqs.title: Do I need to be an experienced climber to summit Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: No previous climbing experience is necessary to summit Kilimanjaro. However, a good level of physical fitness, preparation, and understanding of altitude sickness are important for a successful climb.

faqs.title: What are the different routes to climb Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: There are several routes to summit Kilimanjaro, including the Marangu, Machame, Lemosho, and Rongai routes. Each varies in difficulty, scenery, and duration, so choose one that aligns with your preferences and fitness level.

faqs.title: What should I pack for climbing Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: Essential gear includes layered clothing, a waterproof jacket, sturdy hiking boots, a sleeping bag rated for cold temperatures, trekking poles, a headlamp, and personal items like sunscreen, a hat, and a water bottle. Consult your tour operator for a comprehensive packing list.

faqs.title: How high is Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: Mount Kilimanjaro stands at approximately 5,895 meters (19,341 feet) above sea level, making it the highest peak in Africa.

faqs.title: What is altitude sickness, and how can I prevent it?
faqs.content: Altitude sickness occurs when your body struggles to acclimatize to high elevations, leading to symptoms like headache, nausea, and fatigue. To minimize the risk, ascend slowly, stay hydrated, and consider taking a medication like Diamox. Listen to your body and communicate with your guides.

faqs.title: Are there age restrictions for climbing Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: Yes, climbers must be at least 10 years old to trek Kilimanjaro, and those under 18 should be accompanied by an adult. Some operators have specific age limits, so check with your chosen tour company.

faqs.title: Will I need a guide to climb Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: Yes, all climbers are required to go with a licensed guide and a support team. This is essential for safety, navigation, and to comply with Tanzanian regulations.

faqs.title: What is the success rate for reaching the summit?
faqs.content: Success rates vary by route, but generally hover around 50-65% for shorter treks. Longer routes that allow for better acclimatization tend to have higher success rates, often exceeding 80%.

faqs.title: Is there a chance of communication during the climb?
faqs.content: You may have limited cell phone coverage on certain routes, but it’s advisable to expect minimal connectivity. Most trekkers focus on enjoying the experience and the beautiful surroundings rather than staying connected.

itinerary.title: Day 1
itinerary.content:
Upon your arrival at

Kilimanjaro International Airport

, our dedicated driver will be there to warmly greet you, holding a sign with your name for easy identification. This seamless and comfortable transfer service will take you to the charming

Hotel

.

At the hotel, you will be welcomed with a delicious meal. Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing. This is an exciting opportunity to learn about the upcoming adventure and the wonders that await you on your trek.

Take advantage of the relaxing environment at the Hotel, featuring a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant, ensuring you start your journey on a comfortable note.

Overnight: Sal salinero hotel or similar

itinerary.title: Day 2
itinerary.desc: Moshi to Londorossi Gate then Shira 1
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 890 meters (2,920 feet) - 3,505 meters (11,500 feet) above sea level.

After enjoying breakfast at

Hotel

and receiving essential instructions from your guide, you’ll embark on a

1.5-hour drive

to

Londorossi Park Gate

(2250m). Following your guide’s advice is crucial for avoiding altitude sickness, as you’ll be climbing to significant elevations, with your first night at

Shira 1 Camp

.

At

Londorossi Gate

, you’ll complete a brief registration before entering the national park. Following this, you’ll have a short drive along

Shira Road

to the

Moram Picnic Site

, which takes about

45 minutes

. From there, you’ll start your

7 km hike

to

Shira 1 Camp

, typically taking

3 to 4 hours

depending on your pace. You’ll have a restful overnight stay at

Shira 1

, preparing for the next day’s trek to

Shira 2 Camp

.

This day sets the tone for your journey, allowing you to acclimatize while enjoying the stunning scenery along the way.

itinerary.title: Day 3
itinerary.desc: Trek from Shira 1 Camp to Shira 2 Camp
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,500m – 3,840 m
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 5 to 6 hours

On this day, you’ll wake up early for breakfast before starting the brief hike from

Shira 1

to

Shira 2 Camp

. This trek typically takes

5 to 6 hours

and is considered relatively easy, allowing you to take in the breathtaking views of the African landscape.

Upon reaching the

Shira 2 campsite

, our dedicated porters will handle all arrangements, including pitching tents while our chef prepares your lunch. After enjoying your meal, you’ll have some time to unwind and rest until dinnertime.

In the evening, after dinner, our experienced guide will brief you about the trekking plans for the following day, ensuring you are well-prepared for the next leg of your adventure.

This day is perfect for acclimatization and enjoying the spectacular surroundings, making it a memorable part of your Kilimanjaro journey.

itinerary.title: Day 4
itinerary.desc: Trek from Shira 2 Camp to Barranco Camp
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,840 m – 3,960 m
  • Hiking distance: 11 km
  • Hiking time: 7 to 8 hours

Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s route includes a climb to

Lava Tower

at

4,630m

, where you’ll pass through a semi-desert, rocky landscape. After a

5-hour hike

, you’ll enjoy lunch at Lava Tower, giving you a chance to recharge before ascending the rocky scree path. This demanding day might test your endurance as you acclimatize to the higher altitude.

Following lunch, you’ll descend

680m

to

Barranco Camp

, where you’ll truly experience the benefits of acclimatization. This

2-hour descent

offers stunning photo opportunities of the

Western Breach

, a dramatic cliff face that adds to the day’s breathtaking scenery. End the day with a memorable sunset and dinner at Barranco Camp, surrounded by the incredible landscapes that make your Kilimanjaro adventure truly unforgettable.

This day is designed to help you acclimatize properly while enjoying the stunning beauty of the mountain.

itinerary.title: Day 5
itinerary.desc: Trek from Barranco Camp to Karanga Camp
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,960 m – 4,035 m
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 5 hours

Start your day early with a wake-up call and a nourishing breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s journey may involve ascending the famous

Barranco Wall

, a steep but rewarding section that offers spectacular views as you climb. After conquering the Wall, you’ll descend into the scenic

Karanga Valley

, known for its lush vegetation and breathtaking landscapes. This descent allows for beautiful photo opportunities while you take in the stunning surroundings.

Upon reaching the

Karanga campsite

, our dedicated porters will set up your tents while our chef prepares a delicious lunch for you. After your meal, you’ll embark on an acclimatization hike towards

Barafu Camp

, ascending

200 meters

before returning to camp. This acclimatization effort is essential to prepare your body for the higher altitudes ahead. In the evening, enjoy a hot meal prepared by our chef, providing you with the energy needed for the next day’s challenges. Following dinner, your experienced guide will brief you on the next day’s trek, discussing the route, challenges, and key details to ensure you’re well-prepared for the adventure that lies ahead.

This day is crucial for acclimatization and serves as a perfect balance of challenging ascents and well-deserved relaxation amidst nature’s beauty.

itinerary.title: Day 6
itinerary.desc: Trek from Karanga Camp to Barafu Camp
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 4,035 m – 4,640 m
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 5 hours

Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek toward

Barafu campsite

. The trail features varied terrain, including rocky sections and gradual slopes, providing breathtaking views of Kilimanjaro’s high-altitude landscapes. As you ascend, it’s crucial to focus on acclimatization to avoid altitude-related issues, which can impact your trekking experience significantly. Upon reaching

Barafu

, our porters will efficiently handle camp setup while our chef prepares a nutritious lunch to replenish your energy. After eating, take some time to rest and prepare mentally and physically for the challenges ahead.

In the evening, your guide will conduct a detailed briefing on the upcoming summit attempt, covering the route, challenges, safety measures, and essential preparations to ensure your success. This is a vital moment to clarify any questions you may have and to solidify your plans for the summit.

Try to rest well during the day, as the summit ascent will begin late in the evening, and a good night’s sleep will be crucial for your performance during this critical stage of your adventure.This day is pivotal for building the stamina and mental strength needed for the final climb, and every effort you make here will contribute to your success on the summit.

itinerary.title: Day 7
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 4,640 m – 5, 895 m – 3,090 m
  • Hiking distance: 17 km
  • Hiking & descending time: 15+ hours

You’ll rise around

11:30 PM

to begin your ascent after enjoying some tea and biscuits. The trek will lead you northwest as you climb through scree towards

Stella Point

on the crater rim. This

6-hour trek

to

Stella Point (5685m)

is often considered the most mentally and physically challenging part of the climb, testing your endurance and determination. After a brief rest at

Stella Point

, you will be rewarded with a magnificent sunrise, weather permitting, as you take in the stunning views. From Stella Point, you will embark on a

2-hour ascent

across a snow-covered path to

Uhuru Peak

, the highest point on Mount Kilimanjaro.

Be mindful that your time at the summit may be limited due to cold temperatures and fatigue, so it’s important not to linger too long. The descent back to

Barafu Camp

takes about

3 hours

, where you will have a short rest before continuing your journey to

Mweka Camp

for dinner and an overnight stay.

This day is the culmination of your efforts and will offer unforgettable views and a sense of achievement as you stand atop Africa’s highest peak.

itinerary.title: Day 8
itinerary.desc: MWEKA CAMP | MWEKA PARK GATE | MOSHI
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,090 m – 1,650 m
  • Hiking distance: 10 km
  • Descending time: 4-5 hours

After enjoying breakfast at

Mweka Camp

, you will begin your descent to

Mweka Gate

, where your trek concludes. Following the completion of your hike, a transfer will take you back to your

Hotel

, where a hot lunch and a refreshing shower await you, providing the perfect opportunity to relax and celebrate your accomplishment.

As your trip comes to an end, please consider showing your appreciation to the trekking team with a tip. Special envelopes for this purpose are available at the hotel, ensuring that your gratitude reaches those who supported you on your journey.

If you wish to extend your adventure, you can meet with our safari coordinator at the hotel. After some rest, they will provide a briefing on various safari options available, allowing you to experience Tanzania’s stunning wildlife and natural beauty. We highly recommend booking a safari with us, as it will truly make your journey unforgettable.

Overnight: Sal salinero hotel or similar

itinerary.title: Day 9
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. This is a great time to reflect on your incredible journey and the unforgettable experiences you’ve had in Tanzania. If you’re looking to extend your adventure, consider adding a day trip to your itinerary, where you can explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. More details can be found on our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you may wish to continue your travels with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you seek relaxation on pristine beaches or an exploration of the island’s vibrant culture, Zanzibar has something for every traveler. For more information on the perfect package for your next excursion, visit our Zanzibar page. You can also consider booking a safari to experience Tanzania’s renowned wildlife. Our Safari page offers detailed information on various options, ensuring you capture the breathtaking natural beauty and wildlife that this incredible country has to offer.
